text:
eli: quick check-in on RFC appendix draft for envelope + sampling. want to make sure rollout playbook covers edge cases we saw last quarter.

marta: main gaps I saw: ignored private deployments, edge-case where a proxy strips envelope headers, and console UX for "inferred vs attributed" splits.

oscar: proxy stripping is real. propose SDK attach should also try header-based and body-based fallbacks and emit a provenance flag if fallback used. that way queries can filter unreliable attributions.

eli: good. for console UX, show a per-service banner when inferred attribution > 5% with guidance to enable billing-authorized flag. small CTA to open a runbook.

devx: also add a lint rule in our instrumentation-linter: warn if a service calls attachBillingAttrs() but isn't marked billing-authorized in the manifest. prevent the common mistake.

marta: on sampling: confirm hashed buckets are stored alongside sample_rate metadata. also store sample_origin (sdk|gateway|edge) so we know where the hash came from.

oscar: infra-bot: can we schedule a canary of envelope.v1 in staging for one week?

infra-bot: scheduling canary: infra-canary-23 assigned, window next Tue-Fri.

eli: action items: marta update appendix with proxy fallback + provenance flags (due Mon), devx add linter rule (PR by Wed), oscar schedule staging canary (done). we'll review in RFC thread after canary metrics.

marta: noted. I'll include example queries that identify "suspected proxy strip" by comparing trace.attr_count vs envelope.meta_count.

eli: thanks team, this is getting tight but feels safer than global propagation. we'll iterate after canary. :+1:
